text:
maria_support: Heads-up — customer reported intermittent 400 dimension-mismatch errors and tail latency spikes hitting the embeddings endpoint. They say it happens under bursty traffic and sometimes a 401 appears for a subset of requests. Pasting their short repro below.

jordan_cs: Customer is a mid-market PLG app. Started after they increased parallel client workers. They saw ~5% of embedding calls return "dim mismatch: expected 1536 got 0" and some 401s that correlate with billing token refreshes.

marian_support: Repro steps they gave: 10 concurrent curl requests with small payloads, model rwd-embed-v2. Payload snippet: ```json
{
  "model": "rwd-embed-v2",
  "input": ["short text"],
  "max_batch_size": 64
}
``` They said when they set max_batch_size to 8 it mostly stops.

tyler_sre: Thanks — can we get logs for the failing requests? specifically request_ids and worker shard ids. Also need the sequence of auth refresh events for that account.

nick_runtime: I pulled the route traces for the times they mentioned. There are multiple attempts routed to different batchers, and I see one worker returning a serialization error prior to embedding generation: `kvcache mismatch: expected length 1536, got 0` — looks like an interleaving bug when coalescing small requests into a batch.

sophia_ml: That explains the dim mismatch. If kv cache or padding goes wrong we can end up with truncated tensors. Does the serialization path differ when max_batch_size is large?

nick_runtime: Yes — with large max_batch_size we enable a fallback coalescing optimization that streams payloads into a shared buffer. There's a known race if a request is preempted by another and its length metadata isn't flushed. Not high frequency but surfaces under high concurrency and small inputs.

marian_support: What about the 401s? Customer says the 401s are intermittent and line up with a billing token rotation. Could be unrelated but they overlap in time.

opsbot: [ops] billing-token-rotation event for account acct_9c8 at 2024-11-02T18:02:14Z. Token swap took ~3s.

tyler_sre: If token rotation caused transient 401s some client libraries may retry and flood the backend, increasing coalescing pressure — could amplify the coalescing race. Two issues compounding.

nick_runtime: Quick mitigation: disable shared-buffer coalescing for embeddings route (config flag `batcher.coalesce_shared=false`) and force per-request padding in the worker. I can push a guarded flag change to canary pool.

sophia_ml: Also recommend adding a server-side dim-check earlier to short-circuit and respond 400 with clearer error if pad/serialization produced 0-length vector. That avoids propagating through the model.

nick_runtime: Deploybot, canary patch with `batcher.coalesce_shared=false` to pool embed-canary-2? Keep max_batch_size unchanged so customers won't need code changes.

deploybot: ack — scheduling canary deploy to embed-canary-2 now. Expected minute runway 5m. Rolling back automatically if error rate > 1%.

marian_support: Sent customer the temporary workaround: set client `max_batch_size` to 8 and retry. Asked them to share request_ids for failures.

jordan_cs: Customer replied: they tried max_batch_size=8 and failures dropped to ~0.3%. Provided request ids: rid: r-0a1b2, r-0a1b9, r-0a1c0. Also attached small SDK logs showing 401: `{"error":"Unauthorized","code":401}` during token swap window.

tyler_sre: Good. I'll correlate rids to worker shards. Also will instrument a histogram for tail latency on embeddings per-batcher and include coalescer contention tags.

nick_runtime: Canary patch is live on embed-canary-2. Early telemetry shows 60% reduction in dim-mismatch 400s on that pool. No regression in latency for normal traffic.

sophia_ml: I'll add an eval job that runs a short burst test (1000 small requests at concurrency 20) against canary to validate stability and catch regression in embedding quality.

marian_support: Customer updated: after we requested they pause auto-scaling for a bit while we observe, they report near-zero dim errors. They've unpaused and will report if it reappears.

tyler_sre: Action items: 1) nick to land the coalescer guard in stable if canary stays green (ETA 24h). 2) sophia to add server-side early dim-check and a small unit test for serialization races (ETA 48h). 3) infra to add alert for token-rotation-induced retry floods (ETA 72h). 4) support to advise customers to lower client max_batch_size as a temporary workaround.

nick_support: Noted — I will update the support KB entry with repro steps and the temporary mitigation. Include sample curl above and mention `max_batch_size=8` workaround.

jordan_cs: Customer appreciated the quick turnaround and asked if we can proactively detect when their account's tail error rate spikes and auto-route them away from coalescing pools.

nick_runtime: We can add policy: if account error-rate(400,dim-mismatch) > 0.5% over 5m then route to non-coalescing pool. I'll prototype as part of the fix.

marian_support: Thanks team. Leaving thread open until stable patch to main is deployed. Please post final roll-forward here.

opsbot: [monitor] embed-canary-2 dim-mismatch errors decreased from 0.9% -> 0.35% within 10m post-patch.

nick_runtime: Final update (later): main has the guarded coalescer flag off by default for embeddings; dim-check added server-side; policy for auto-routing on dim-mismatch spikes created. Customer confirmed no further errors after a day. Closing.
